recipes.name: High-Protein Skyr & Blueberry Oatmeal
recipes.description: Quick high-protein breakfast bowl with rolled oats, Icelandic skyr, and fresh blueberries.
instructions: Simmer 60g rolled oats with 150ml milk or water for 5 minutes until creamy.
Remove from heat and stir in 150g natural Skyr yogurt.
Top with 70g fresh blueberries and 10g chopped walnuts.

recipes.name: Polish Buckwheat & Grilled Chicken Power Bowl
recipes.description: Balanced post-workout meal featuring roasted buckwheat groats, chicken breast, and steamed broccoli.
instructions: Cook 80g dry roasted buckwheat groats in salted water for 15 minutes.
Season 200g chicken breast with herbs and pan-sear for 6 minutes per side.
Steam 150g broccoli florets for 5 minutes and serve with 10ml olive oil.

recipes.name: Vegan Chickpea & Crispy Tofu Bowl
recipes.description: Plant-based protein bowl with pan-seared soy tofu, chickpeas, baby spinach, and basmati rice.
instructions: Press and cube 180g firm tofu, then pan-sear until golden on all sides.
Warm 120g cooked chickpeas with baby spinach and spices in the same pan.
Serve over 80g cooked basmati rice with sliced avocado.

recipes.name: Pan-Seared Atlantic Salmon with Young Potatoes
recipes.description: Omega-3 rich salmon fillet paired with boiled potatoes and wilted garlic spinach.
instructions: Boil 220g halved potatoes until fork-tender (about 18 minutes).
Sear 180g salmon fillet skin-side down for 4 minutes, flip and cook 3 minutes more.
Wilt 100g fresh spinach in a teaspoon of olive oil and plate alongside.

recipes.name: Traditional Polish Twaróg Rye Tartines
recipes.description: Classic Polish high-protein breakfast on wholegrain rye sourdough bread.
instructions: Mash 150g semi-skimmed twaróg with 2 tablespoons of natural skyr and chopped chives.
Spread generously over two slices (100g) of wholegrain rye sourdough bread.
Season with freshly cracked black pepper and sea salt.
